<!-- main-pr533-retired-pr534-held-20260918 -->
MAIN retired #533 as superseded, without merging or changing its branch.
The actual API now reports closed/unmerged at unchanged `e371f227`; clean
unpublished `d2e021eb` is also preserved. Issue #518 remains open.

The released independent report establishes that the branch's only added
theorem and completed Alice point-consistency proof already exist in
`Extraction/SuppliedPointConsistency.lean`. The latter has the explicit
`_ofGlobalPairWitness` name on main. Relevant source inputs remain unchanged
from the report's main pin `c199efa7`. There is no unique blueprint edit or
current-documentation contribution, and no active citation to the missing
historical audit path was found.

The unique 191-line audit and eleven-line CI incident were preserved verbatim
with the source commit, Git blob, SHA-256 and actual latest review in
`owner-audits/supersession-20260917/pr533-preserved-history.jsonl`. Review
5194177472's F2/F3 corrections remain explicit: the old audit lacks required
metadata and misstates both the proof dependency and its axiom closure. The
archive is dated evidence, not current mathematical documentation or a new
approval. The branch's original review/status evidence was not rewritten.
A bounded helper supplement will verify the original issue518 statement and
fresh target axioms on published main before any separate issue completion.

#534 remains open. MAIN checked the report's claim that all six residual
helpers were private: at least three are public declarations. Its entire
`RestrictedConsistency.lean` is byte-identical to publishing #467, and the
public resampling helper is also queued in approved #456. Those branches must
integrate first; other unique helper evidence and the historical audit remain
to be accounted for. No stale chapter or unsupported source-level leanok is
being restored. Both reports and these qualifications are archived.

#467's same publisher and pre-push processes remain live and continue through
successful targeted builds. There is no competing MAIN publisher. Its fresh
review follows release/green CI; then #456, #299, #481. Sol/Ultra Carson's sole
native #536 task is active in its isolated worktree with the 19:06Z outer
deadline. The cycle snapshot completed; the previous cycle was progress by
starting that bounded preservation task. Caps0/0/0, no lanes, daemon-only
merges, no #168 post, and the full formalization goal remains active.
